peft.standalone: Ɗu'um LoRA / PEFT adaptor yiɗi ko hewti basiira moodel man. Nasta basiira nden hawta adaptor nder Safetensors provider; mawnugo adaptor tan naa ɗum ko yiɗi nder hakkilo.
peft.description: Suɓii kala moodelwol darnde fuu to dow, nden kadi suɓii deftere maako nde adaptor. Adaptor tan naa ɗum moodelwol darnde fuu. Anndal darnde fuu doole laato nanndi e darnde konfigurasyonwol adaptor.
peft.estimate: Conservative CPU estimate at 2,048 tokens. Recalculated for the selected device and context at loading time. Target modules and tensor shapes are checked during loading.

noInstalledModels: Wala ko nandi e maajum nder darnde nde’e.
limitedSupport: Ɗum waɗay ƴamtal dow ko hokkata ɗum. Ɓesda moodelji manngo. Ngam kala moodel fu, holla ko ɗum hokkata kuutinirɗi, hooto, e ko hollata. Kuutinirɗi ɗi'i waawataa heɓaama dow laawol ngol.
mlxExperimental: MLX wallitaaki ɗum foonduye. Embeddings yo walaa, ko wi'etee reasoning toggle yo walaa, kadin goɗɗi moodelji kesi ɗin mbaaway taƴeeki. Annda kaɓɓoduuji dow GitHub ngam annda kaɓɓoduuji ɗin.
engineBundled: Inference engine e waɗaa nder Novera, ngam non walaa ko heɓtoyta maabo wadduki pecce feereeje. Anndiray kala foonduwal ngol to ko wi'etee misaalu ngaɗaangol heɓtoyki.
engineOtherVersion: E ɗum yiɗi foonduye fere nde llama.cpp? Huwira e llama-server nden ɓesda ɗum bana foonduye nde OpenAI.
refreshModelsError: Ko hokkata doole woodi darnde URL kadin ko seɗɗa nder kawtal API ko tagirtee ngam heɓtuki moodele.
noNewModels: Wala moodelji kesi heɓaaka. Kala moodelwol fuu ko heɓaaka ɓesdaama.
refreshModelsFailed: Na waawi heɓuki moodelji gila {{provider}}. Toɓɓen laara keyri API e darnde URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Ɗum naftirtee ngam RAG e kadin heɓtoyki vektorji. Ɗum suɓii foonduwol ngol wartii ngo'ol to ɗum heɓtoyke embeddings.
embeddingModelIsDefault: Ɗum woni ɗatal kuutinirngal ngol naftirteengal.
importedTooltip: Nastinaama daga deftere nder leydi. Nastinaaki ɗum daga Novera waawai nastinaaki deftere nden dow diski.
noModelFoundDesc: Ɗuuɗal moodelji ɗin e woodi to ɗon. To ɗum walaa moodel fuu, ɗum waawata nastugo to Hub.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Ɗuuɗal moodelji ɗin e heɓirtee e darnde nde'e. Ɗu'um naftoraama ngam heɓtuki moodelji ɗin gila wadduɗo man, maa boo ɓesda go'o ta laawol +.

addModel.title: Ɓesda suura kesi
addModel.description: Ɗum ɓesdi moodel kesum yaago {{provider}} ko hokkata.

deleteModel.choiceDescription: Suɓi no ɗum waaway huuwa nga'al misaalu ngal gila Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Ɓaɓɓina noone nden daga limgal nden e hoosa fiiji ɗin dow diski. Ɓe waaway nastina ɗum.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Waɗugo noone nden e binndi ɗi Novera-managed gila diski. Nde'e waawata waɗugo.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Ɗum maa sankitii deftere mawnde nde GGUF to nokkuure maare aranndeere. Diidol deftere nden hewti. Nde'e waawata sankitii.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Model {{modelId}} wurtinaama gila Novera. Fiilaaji maɓɓiiraama.
deleteModel.title: Ɗaɓɓitugo noone: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Ko o tammi o yiɗi sankitii moobgal ngol? Kuugal ngol waawataa sankitii.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Ɓaɓɓina nga'al moodel ngol nastinaangal gila Novera? Nastinaaki fiiji ɗin dow diski ɗin waawataa.

deleteAllModels.title: Ɗum sankitii kala moodelwol fuu?
deleteAllModels.description: Ɗu'um waaway huuwa darnde nden nde {{count}} misaaluuji gila diski.
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} ɓoggi nastinaɗi e hoositiree (fayliiji maɓɓe e hoositiree nde Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Na waawi nyaamki {{count}} moodele. Raaru console ngam bayaanuuji.

deleteProvider.title: Nastina
deleteProvider.description: Nastina keeriiji ɗi'i e kala moodelji ɗin fuu. Kuutinirgel nga'al waawata nastinaaka.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Yaake o yiɗi sankitiiɗum nde o yiɗi sankitii ɗum? Na ɗum waaway sankitii ɗum.

editModel.title: Waylugo suura: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Tabbitinii kuuɗe suuraaji ta wannginki suɓɓiire ɗen les.

warning.title: Jaaɗi e hakkilanki
warning.description: Ɗum waaway waylugo kuuɗe ɗen boo ɗum waaway sanjaaki kuuɗe ɗen. Ɗum waaway wadduki ɗate ngaɗaaɗee malla boo ɓoggi.

baseUrl.title: Dabare URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Your Azure OpenAI Ɗum wayliti darnde. YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME be innde Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Ɗum naftiri e darnde nde'e ngam nokkuure kuugal Alibaba Cloud e nokkuure nden. Ɓe wayliti YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID e nokkuure kuugal ID nden ɓe naftiri e API daga nokkuure nden.

apiKeys.title: API keyji
apiKeys.description: Nasta key API. Ɓe waaway ɓesda keyji goɗɗi nder Advanced, nden Novera e foonda ko tokkata to keyji ɗin nasti.
apiKeys.testHint: Tayaka /models e kala key fuu kadin holla darorde kala key fuu.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Ɗuuɗal taƴooɗe foonduɗe e ɗe taƴooɗe nder Advanced.
